posts.title: uc-local-apex-dev 26.5: better backups, utPLSQL, and more
posts.description: uc-local-apex-dev 26.5 backs up objects that a Data Pump schema export misses, rebuilds your local database in one command, and adds utPLSQL installation and space management tools.

posts.title: Deep Data Security is here to stay #JoelKallmanDay
posts.description: I think Deep Data Security (DDS) is one of the most promising additions to Oracle 26ai. The idea is straightforward: describe who may read or change which data with SQL, and let the database enforce it.

posts.title: Make APEXlang Easy: Makefiles and Merge-Safe Imports
posts.description: How a makefile turns the SQLcl, Git and dbLinter commands of an APEX project into short make commands, and how a Git-based sync script stops APEXlang imports from overwriting your colleagues' App Builder changes.
